jobs.title: JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant
jobs.description:
JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant

Particle41 is seeking a talented and versatile JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant to join our innovative team. We are staffing a dedicated consultant for a large enterprise client that runs JD Edwards as its core ERP. The client needs someone who knows the JDE data model inside and out and can build reliable data pipelines around it. This is a working seat on the client team, not a short advisory project. You will work shoulder to shoulder with their ERP, IT, and business teams every day.

In This Role, You Will:
Own JDE data work: Extract, model, and transform data from JD Edwards tables (Address Book, Item Master, Sales Order, General Ledger, and related files).
Build data pipelines: Design and maintain ETL/ELT flows from JDE into the client's data warehouse or reporting platform.
Support ERP implementation work: Lead data mapping, conversion, cleansing, and reconciliation for implementation, upgrade, or migration efforts. Support cutover planning and execution.
Enable reporting: Build clean, trusted datasets for BI dashboards and finance and operations reporting.
Protect data quality: Set up validation and reconciliation checks between JDE and downstream systems. Find and fix root causes.
Partner with the business: Work with finance, distribution, and manufacturing users to turn their questions into data requirements.
Document as you go: Keep data flows, mappings, and conversion rules clear and current for the client team.

Skills and Experience We Value:
5+ years of hands-on JD Edwards experience (EnterpriseOne and/or World). Deep knowledge of the JDE data model and table structures is required for this role.
Strong SQL on Oracle, SQL Server, or DB2 / IBM i (AS400).
Data engineering experience: ETL/ELT development, pipeline design, and data modeling.
At least one full-cycle ERP implementation, upgrade, or migration where you owned data conversion or data migration work.
Working knowledge of core JDE modules: Financials, Distribution / Logistics, and Manufacturing.
Able to work full-time during US business hours.
Clear, confident written and spoken English. Comfortable working directly with client stakeholders.
Able to work as an independent contractor.

Nice to Have
JDE technical tools: Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), UBEs / Report Design Aid, Table Conversion, and Form Design Aid.
Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS (Glue, Redshift), or dbt.
BI tools: Power BI, Tableau, or OBIEE.
Python for data processing and automation.
Industry background in manufacturing, distribution, or automotive aftermarket.
Oracle JD Edwards certification.
Prior consulting or staff augmentation experience.

What Success Looks Like
First 30 days: You understand the client's JDE footprint, key tables, and current data flows. You deliver a first pipeline or dataset fix.
First 90 days: The client team trusts your data. Reporting and conversion work runs on documented, repeatable pipelines.
Ongoing: You are the go-to person for JDE data questions on the client team.

About Particle41
Our core values of Empowering, Leadership, Innovation, Teamwork, and Excellence drive everything we do to achieve the ultimate outcomes for our clients. Empowering Leadership for Innovation in Teamwork with Excellence ( ELITE )

E - Empowering: Enabling individuals to reach their full potential.
L - Leadership: Taking initiative and guiding each other toward success.
I - Innovation: Embracing creativity and new ideas to stay ahead.
T - Teamwork: Collaborating with empathy to achieve common goals.
E - Excellence: Striving for the highest quality in everything we do.

We seek team members who embody these values and are committed to contributing to our mission. Particle41 welcomes individuals from all backgrounds who are committed to our mission and values. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, ensuring that hiring and employment decisions are based on merit and qualifications without discrimination based on race, color, religion, caste, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, local, or international laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment and hiring.
We appreciate your interest and encourage applicants from these regions to apply. If you need any assistance during the application or interview process, please feel free to reach out to us at careers@particle41.com. This role is specifically for LATAM Region only.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Analytics
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
  • We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
  • We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
  • We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

The Manager, Business Analytics is a highly technical individual contributor within the Sales Operations & Business Analytics (SOBA) Center of Excellence. You will serve as a strategic analytics partner across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and other business functions, leveraging advanced analytics, statistical modeling, data science, and automation to improve operational performance, revenue realization, and business decision-making. The successful candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen, translating complex data into actionable insights that influence leadership decisions and drive measurable business outcomes. Working at the intersection of analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, and operational strategy, this individual partners closely with stakeholders across the enterprise to build scalable analytical solutions that enable data-driven decision-making.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the analytics lead supporting Commercial, Finance, Operations, and related organizational functions.
  • Act as a thought partner to operational and commercial leadership, helping prioritize analytical investments, define success metrics, and measure business outcomes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure analytical solutions are aligned with strategic priorities and deliver measurable value to the business.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable analytical solutions using SQL, Python, Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI, and modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Perform statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, hypothesis testing, predictive modeling, and exploratory data analysis to support business planning and operational decision-making.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, IT, and Master Data Management teams to define data requirements, improve data quality, optimize data pipelines, and enhance enterprise data architecture.
  • Build and maintain semantic data models, reusable datasets, KPI frameworks, and standardized metrics aligned with SOBA governance standards.
  • Support enterprise data governance initiatives by validating source system integrity, documenting metric definitions, monitoring data quality, and promoting reporting consistency.
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics techniques where appropriate to improve forecasting accuracy, automate decision support, and uncover new business insights.

Who You Are:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 6-8+ years of experience in advanced analytics, business intelligence, data science, revenue analytics, or a similar technical analytical role.
  • Expert-level SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), query optimization, and dimensional data modeling.
  • Strong Python programming experience, including the use of libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, StatsModels, Scikit-Learn, and data visualization frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data governance, and data quality management practices, including cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse, or similar technologies
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar business intelligence platforms, including dashboard development and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large, complex datasets and communicate findings through compelling narratives, insights, and recommendations.
  • Ability to independently manage ambiguous problems and deliver high-impact solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience within diagnostics, laboratory services, healthcare technology, life sciences, or payer analytics environments.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, generative AI applications, workflow automation platforms, and emerging analytics technologies.
  • Experience partnering with executive stakeholders to influence strategic business decisions through data-driven insights.

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data team, comprising both Data Scientists, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers. Our team is at the forefront of enhancing data analysis efficiency and effectiveness. Our data engineers develop and maintain data pipelines integral to our analytics data model.

As a Data Engineer, your primary responsibility will be designing and maintaining data pipelines, primarily utilizing SparkSQL and Pyspark, within our central data lake. These pipelines are crucial for ingesting and transforming source data from our IOT devices and software products into our core data model, facilitating statistical analysis, model training, and dashboard creation.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain highly reliable computed tables, incorporating data from various sources, including unstructured data like video and audio, Samsara sensor & product data, and customer metadata.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Observability & Telemetry Data
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Observability Engineering owns the breadth and depth of observability and telemetry at Smartsheet. We build and operate the shared platform every engineering team depends on to understand how their software behaves in production (metrics, logs, distributed traces, RUM, synthetics, and AI/agentic telemetry) across a global, multi-region, commercial and government footprint. We are consolidating ownership of all of it into a single correlated platform, and treating telemetry as what it actually is: one of the largest and most valuable datasets at the company. It's a broad mandate with real scope to shape, and we hold this internal platform to the same rigor, reliability, and product standards as customer-facing software.

As a Principal Software Engineer (Observability & Telemetry Data), you will set the technical direction for how Smartsheet collects, models, stores, and derives value from telemetry data. This is an architect role: you will define the telemetry data platform and the standards that govern it, carry that architecture across engineering org boundaries, partner with our Data and AI Platform teams on Databricks and MLflow integration, and act as the company's definitive technical voice on observability. You will influence roadmaps you do not own, resolve the hard design trade-offs between fidelity and cost, and raise the technical bar for every engineer instrumenting a service.

This full-time position reports to the Team Lead, Observability Engineering and can be located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will

  • Architect the Telemetry Data Platform: Own the end-to-end design for how telemetry is landed, modeled, and queried, including open table formats, partitioning and schema evolution strategy, separation of storage and compute, tiered retention, and the query interfaces engineers actually use. Make telemetry a durable, portable, Smartsheet-owned dataset rather than a vendor-locked byproduct.
  • Own the Telemetry Data Model: Define the semantic conventions, shared business identifiers (user, org, plan, tenant), and schema standards that let any signal be correlated with any other, and drive their adoption across every service team at Smartsheet.
  • Set OpenTelemetry Direction: Lead the migration to OTel-based instrumentation, defining collector architecture, context propagation, and sampling strategy (including tail-based sampling) so that engineers can move from a log line to a trace to a metric without losing the thread.
  • Integrate AI and Agentic Telemetry with Databricks: Own the architecture connecting our observability platform to Databricks and MLflow, so that agentic and model telemetry (prompt, completion, tool and MCP calls, evaluation results) is captured un-sampled, stays useful under the input/output redaction our governance requires, and reconciles cleanly with the traces and metrics in our primary observability stack.
  • Instrument the Data Platform Itself: Bring first-class observability to our data estate, including Databricks jobs, pipelines, and warehouses, with meaningful signals for freshness, data quality, lineage, and cost, so data reliability is measured with the same discipline as service reliability.
  • Build the Analytics Layer on Telemetry: Turn telemetry into decision-grade analytics, covering reliability and incident metrics, telemetry cost and chargeback models, and adoption and coverage reporting that leadership can act on.
  • Engineer Collection and Routing at Scale: Architect the high-volume collection and routing tier (FluentBit, Kinesis, and OTel collectors) that moves telemetry from every service to its destination across US, EU, AU, and GovCloud regions, and own the migration of these pipelines as we consolidate onto a unified backend.
  • Own Telemetry Economics: Set the cost architecture for observability data, including ingest governance, cardinality control, and storage tiering, so that teams get the fidelity they need to debug without the spend pressure that causes them to under-instrument.
  • Carry Architecture Across Org Boundaries: Partner with the Data Platform, AI Platform, and infrastructure organizations to align telemetry architecture with theirs, influence roadmaps you do not own, and represent observability in company-level platform and vendor decisions.
  • Raise the Technical Bar: Lead design and code reviews, author the architecture decisions and standards others build against, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers on instrumentation, telemetry data modeling, and cost-aware design.
  • Participate in a production support and on-call rotation, taking ownership of the most complex issue resolution and driving root-cause analysis that improves system resiliency.

You Have

  • 10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, data platforms, or observability infrastructure, including time at Principal or Staff level.
  • Deep Observability Expertise: Hands-on production ownership of metrics, logs, and distributed tracing at scale, including at least one major backend (Datadog, or comparable) and a working understanding of cardinality and cost mechanics.
  • Telemetry Data Engineering: Demonstrated depth in large-scale data architecture, including open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg), Spark or comparable distributed processing, streaming ingestion, partitioning and schema evolution, and query performance and cost tuning over very large datasets.
  • Databricks Depth: Practical experience with the Databricks platform (jobs, clusters, Unity Catalog, Delta) and with MLflow for model and agent telemetry.
  • OpenTelemetry Depth: Practical experience with OTel collectors, semantic conventions, context propagation, and sampling strategy, including tail-based sampling.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Experience with high-volume log and telemetry pipelines, including FluentBit or Fluentd, streaming transport such as Kinesis or Kafka, and search backend index and mapping design.
  • Advanced AWS & Kubernetes Expertise: EKS, ECS Fargate, EC2, Lambda, and CloudWatch in production.
  • 10+ years of programming experience with modern languages such as Go, Java, Python, or Scala, and strong SQL.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, and GitOps workflows such as Flux or ArgoCD.
  • Architectural Influence at Scale: A track record of setting technical direction that multiple teams and organizations adopted, including the written artifacts (architecture decisions, standards, RFCs) that made it durable after you moved on.
  • Strong incident response instincts, with experience improving mean-time-to-resolution through better instrumentation and better data rather than more heroics.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis

Nice to Have

  • Experience instrumenting LLM or agentic systems, including OTel GenAI semantic conventions and tracing agent tool-call workflows.
  • Data reliability engineering practice: freshness, quality, and lineage SLOs for production data pipelines
  • Telemetry cost engineering or FinOps at scale.
  • Experience in regulated environments (FedRAMP, GovCloud) and designing telemetry that remains useful under redaction.
  • Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager.
  • Snowflake, or experience operating across more than one lakehouse or warehouse platform.
  • Service catalog or internal developer platform work (Backstage or similar).

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range

$222,500—$257,500 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

jobs.title: Field CTO
jobs.description:
The Field CTO is the most senior technical voice in the field. Here's the version we're hiring for.

The Field CTO sits a level above the Solution Architect. Where the SA leads the technical strategy on complex deals, the Field CTO owns the technical narrative across the territory, shapes how the market understands Sigma's architecture, and carries the credibility to win the room when the CTO, CDO, and CISO are all in it. This person does everything a senior SA does, then operates a tier higher: as a peer to enterprise executives, a force multiplier across the entire Solution Engineering team, and a direct line back into Product and Engineering.

Three things sit at the center of this role. The Field CTO does all three at the highest level, with the architectural depth and executive presence to back it up.

1. Use AI every day, and set the standard for how the team uses it.

The Field CTO treats AI tooling as default infrastructure and raises the bar for everyone else. You run Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or equivalents to compress account prep, architecture design, prototype builds, RFP responses, and discovery synthesis from weeks into days. You bring a clear point of view on what to run, why, and where it breaks. You don't just use these tools well. You teach the SE and SA teams how to use them better, and you build the workflows the rest of the field adopts.

2. Sell AI into the account at the executive level.

Buyers want to talk about agents, MCP, A2A, context engineering, and which model powers what. You're fluent, and you can take that conversation to the most senior technical buyer in the building. You know Sigma's AI surface cold: Sigma Assistant in build, analyze, and plan modes, AI functions, input tables with LLM enrichment, MCP integration, Sigma agents, and warehouse agents. You architect these into a customer's stack, defend the tradeoffs to a head of data and a CISO in the same call, and frame the long-term AI strategy for a CTO who's deciding where to place a multi-year bet. You speak credibly about Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and the broader stack the customer already runs.

3. Sell against AI, and own the position the whole team runs.

Every enterprise deal has AI competition in it. Sometimes it's Databricks Genie. Sometimes it's Snowflake Cortex Analyst. Sometimes it's a systems integrator pitching a bespoke agent built over a weekend. You know where each one breaks at scale, where Sigma's warehouse-native architecture wins on governance, freshness, and cost, and how to draw that line for a skeptical CDO without hand-waving. You defend that position in an architecture review, on a security questionnaire, and across a six-month evaluation. Then you turn what you learn into the competitive teardowns and battlecards the entire field uses.

About Sigma

Sigma is the AI runtime environment for the modern enterprise. Teams build apps, agents, and analytics directly in Sigma, with governance and security inherited from the cloud data warehouse. No extracts, no separate AI pipelines, no shadow stack to maintain.

About the role

The Field CTO is the senior-most technical leader in the field organization. You partner with Solution Architects, Solution Engineers, and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers on the largest and most strategic enterprise opportunities, the ones that hinge on architecture, AI strategy, governance, or executive trust. Your job is to win the technical decision at the top of the account and to make the whole team better at winning it.

You'll work across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll carry real influence in all of them. Prospects and customers will come to you as a peer to their own technical leadership. Internally, you'll shape product direction, mentor the SA and SE teams, and represent Sigma's architecture and AI runtime story to the market.

What you'll do

  • Own the technical narrative across the territory's most strategic accounts, partnered with the SAs and SEs working those deals.
  • Lead executive-level architecture and AI strategy conversations with CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, and their senior technical teams.
  • Run deep technical discovery and architecture workshops, and step in to unblock the opportunities no one else can move.
  • Design and build production-grade prototypes and custom apps that prove out high-value use cases, including Sigma plugins, fully code-backed data apps, and AI-driven workflows using Sigma Assistant, Sigma agents, warehouse agents, and MCP integrations. You build in HTML, JavaScript, and Python, both natively in Sigma and as warehouse stored procedures.
  • Lead the hardest security architecture conversations: PrivateLink, OAuth, SAML, SCIM, and the governance model behind them.
  • Present Sigma's architecture and AI runtime story externally: analyst briefings, executive roundtables, conference stages, and CTO-to-CTO conversations.
  • Own the technical position on the hardest RFPs, RFIs, AI risk reviews, and security questionnaires.
  • Advise on integration, migration, governance, and AI patterns across Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, and Redshift.
  • Set Sigma's competitive position against Databricks AI/BI and Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, and AI-native entrants. Defend it with architecture, not slogans, and turn it into reusable assets for the team.

Deep expertise in at least one cloud data warehouse: Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift, and working fluency across the rest. Strong SQL and a deep command of modern data architecture: warehousing, modeling, governance, security.

Data engineering fluency. Hands-on experience with ETL and transformation tooling like dbt, Fivetran, Matillion, or comparable, and the judgment to architect across them.

Builder's depth. You write working code, not just diagrams. Comfortable in HTML, JavaScript, and Python, building custom apps, plugins, and AI workflows end to end, both inside the product and against the warehouse.

Security architecture. Deep command of enterprise security and identity patterns: PrivateLink, OAuth, SAML, SCIM, and the governance decisions that ride on them. You lead these conversations with a CISO, not defer them.

AI fluency at the leading edge. Daily user of modern AI tools and a credible voice on agents, MCP, A2A, context engineering, retrieval, evals, and the major model providers. You position Sigma's AI stack against warehouse agents like Genie and Cortex Analyst, and against AI-native BI entrants, without hand-waving, and you set the team's point of view.

Enterprise selling. Track record of leading and closing the most complex enterprise sales cycles or large BI implementations. You know how to partner with AEs, SAs, and SEs, and how to win the technical decision at the executive level.

jobs.title: Fivetran Reseller Partner Development Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

As the EMEA Resell Partner Development Manager, you will own the growth of our reseller, VAR, and distribution ecosystem across the region, spanning UK&I, DACH, France, Benelux, the Nordics, Southern Europe, and the Middle East and Africa. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Observability & Telemetry Data
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Observability Engineering owns the breadth and depth of observability and telemetry at Smartsheet. We build and operate the shared platform every engineering team depends on to understand how their software behaves in production (metrics, logs, distributed traces, RUM, synthetics, and AI/agentic telemetry) across a global, multi-region, commercial and government footprint. We are consolidating ownership of all of it into a single correlated platform, and treating telemetry as what it actually is: one of the largest and most valuable datasets at the company. It's a broad mandate with real scope to shape, and we hold this internal platform to the same rigor, reliability, and product standards as customer-facing software.

As a Principal Software Engineer (Observability & Telemetry Data), you will set the technical direction for how Smartsheet collects, models, stores, and derives value from telemetry data. This is an architect role: you will define the telemetry data platform and the standards that govern it, carry that architecture across engineering org boundaries, partner with our Data and AI Platform teams on Databricks and MLflow integration, and act as the company's definitive technical voice on observability. You will influence roadmaps you do not own, resolve the hard design trade-offs between fidelity and cost, and raise the technical bar for every engineer instrumenting a service.

This full-time position reports to the Team Lead, Observability Engineering and can be located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will

  • Architect the Telemetry Data Platform: Own the end-to-end design for how telemetry is landed, modeled, and queried, including open table formats, partitioning and schema evolution strategy, separation of storage and compute, tiered retention, and the query interfaces engineers actually use. Make telemetry a durable, portable, Smartsheet-owned dataset rather than a vendor-locked byproduct.
  • Own the Telemetry Data Model: Define the semantic conventions, shared business identifiers (user, org, plan, tenant), and schema standards that let any signal be correlated with any other, and drive their adoption across every service team at Smartsheet.
  • Set OpenTelemetry Direction: Lead the migration to OTel-based instrumentation, defining collector architecture, context propagation, and sampling strategy (including tail-based sampling) so that engineers can move from a log line to a trace to a metric without losing the thread.
  • Integrate AI and Agentic Telemetry with Databricks: Own the architecture connecting our observability platform to Databricks and MLflow, so that agentic and model telemetry (prompt, completion, tool and MCP calls, evaluation results) is captured un-sampled, stays useful under the input/output redaction our governance requires, and reconciles cleanly with the traces and metrics in our primary observability stack.
  • Instrument the Data Platform Itself: Bring first-class observability to our data estate, including Databricks jobs, pipelines, and warehouses, with meaningful signals for freshness, data quality, lineage, and cost, so data reliability is measured with the same discipline as service reliability.
  • Build the Analytics Layer on Telemetry: Turn telemetry into decision-grade analytics, covering reliability and incident metrics, telemetry cost and chargeback models, and adoption and coverage reporting that leadership can act on.
  • Engineer Collection and Routing at Scale: Architect the high-volume collection and routing tier (FluentBit, Kinesis, and OTel collectors) that moves telemetry from every service to its destination across US, EU, AU, and GovCloud regions, and own the migration of these pipelines as we consolidate onto a unified backend.
  • Own Telemetry Economics: Set the cost architecture for observability data, including ingest governance, cardinality control, and storage tiering, so that teams get the fidelity they need to debug without the spend pressure that causes them to under-instrument.
  • Carry Architecture Across Org Boundaries: Partner with the Data Platform, AI Platform, and infrastructure organizations to align telemetry architecture with theirs, influence roadmaps you do not own, and represent observability in company-level platform and vendor decisions.
  • Raise the Technical Bar: Lead design and code reviews, author the architecture decisions and standards others build against, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers on instrumentation, telemetry data modeling, and cost-aware design.
  • Participate in a production support and on-call rotation, taking ownership of the most complex issue resolution and driving root-cause analysis that improves system resiliency.

You Have

  • 10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, data platforms, or observability infrastructure, including time at Principal or Staff level.
  • Deep Observability Expertise: Hands-on production ownership of metrics, logs, and distributed tracing at scale, including at least one major backend (Datadog, or comparable) and a working understanding of cardinality and cost mechanics.
  • Telemetry Data Engineering: Demonstrated depth in large-scale data architecture, including open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg), Spark or comparable distributed processing, streaming ingestion, partitioning and schema evolution, and query performance and cost tuning over very large datasets.
  • Databricks Depth: Practical experience with the Databricks platform (jobs, clusters, Unity Catalog, Delta) and with MLflow for model and agent telemetry.
  • OpenTelemetry Depth: Practical experience with OTel collectors, semantic conventions, context propagation, and sampling strategy, including tail-based sampling.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Experience with high-volume log and telemetry pipelines, including FluentBit or Fluentd, streaming transport such as Kinesis or Kafka, and search backend index and mapping design.
  • Advanced AWS & Kubernetes Expertise: EKS, ECS Fargate, EC2, Lambda, and CloudWatch in production.
  • 10+ years of programming experience with modern languages such as Go, Java, Python, or Scala, and strong SQL.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, and GitOps workflows such as Flux or ArgoCD.
  • Architectural Influence at Scale: A track record of setting technical direction that multiple teams and organizations adopted, including the written artifacts (architecture decisions, standards, RFCs) that made it durable after you moved on.
  • Strong incident response instincts, with experience improving mean-time-to-resolution through better instrumentation and better data rather than more heroics.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis

Nice to Have

  • Experience instrumenting LLM or agentic systems, including OTel GenAI semantic conventions and tracing agent tool-call workflows.
  • Data reliability engineering practice: freshness, quality, and lineage SLOs for production data pipelines
  • Telemetry cost engineering or FinOps at scale.
  • Experience in regulated environments (FedRAMP, GovCloud) and designing telemetry that remains useful under redaction.
  • Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager.
  • Snowflake, or experience operating across more than one lakehouse or warehouse platform.
  • Service catalog or internal developer platform work (Backstage or similar).

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range

$222,500—$257,500 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

  • Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

  • Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

  • Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have

  • Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. About AgentixLake

AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities.

Your role

Build the pipelines and data models that people can depend on. You will own defined components of our data engineering projects, from understanding a source system to delivering tested transformations and monitoring how they run.

Our data platform engineering work connects operational systems with analytics and AI applications. Depending on the project, you will work with cloud warehouses, lakehouse architectures and the data quality and reliability practices that support production use.

What you will do

Build Python and SQL pipelines to ingest and transform data from APIs, databases, files or event sources.

Develop data models and dbt transformations with clear definitions, tests and documentation.

Implement incremental processing, schema checks and reconciliation so changes and data issues are visible.

Configure orchestration and monitoring; investigate failed runs and improve recovery and troubleshooting.

Contribute to cloud data platform components, infrastructure configuration and deployment workflows.

Use Git, pull requests and code review to deliver maintainable changes and explain their impact on downstream users.

What you bring

Current university enrolment in computer science, data science, business informatics or a related technical discipline.

Strong SQL and practical Python, supported by pipelines or data models you have built and maintained for actual users or team workflows.

A sound understanding of data modelling, incremental loads, data quality and the operational behaviour of scheduled pipelines.

Experience with version control and testing, plus practical exposure to a cloud platform, warehouse or orchestration tool.

The ability to own a well-scoped deliverable, investigate problems systematically and communicate clearly in English.

Experience with dbt, Airflow, Dagster, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Apache Iceberg or Terraform is valuable. You do not need experience with every technology; show us where you have developed depth.

What you can expect

You will work on data systems with clear users and delivery requirements, collaborate directly with experienced engineers and the founders, and receive substantive code review. Your part-time responsibilities and schedule will be planned around your studies.

Ingénieur DATA sénior / Senior DATA Engineer (H/F)

CDI

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?

EXPLORE, filiale d’INTESCIA GROUP, est un acteur leader dans le développement de solutions de data intelligence BtoB. Nous produisons des données à forte valeur ajoutée pour accompagner le développement commercial des entreprises, faciliter leurs analyses de marchés et optimiser leur connaissance clients. Nous comptons aujourd’hui plus de 1 500 clients et près de 35 000 utilisateurs dans les univers de l’Immobilier, la Construction, l’Énergie, l’Environnement et des Services à l’entreprise.

Nos atouts ?

  • Un groupe en pleine expansion, reconnu pour son expertise et ses solutions à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Une culture d’innovation, où la créativité et l’amélioration continue sont au cœur de notre ADN.

  • Des équipes passionnées et engagées, évoluant dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif.

Votre mission :

Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data Engineer qui joue un rôle central chez Intescia : ingérer, structurer, fiabiliser et valoriser la donnée vendue aux clients. Vous intégrerez une entreprise en pleine transformation data : migration de la donnée dans Databricks.

En tant que Senior Data Engineer vous aurez un rôle clé dans la mise en place de cette transformation : conception et développement des pipelines de données, mise en place et diffusion des bonnes pratiques de développement et optimisation des performances.

Un des axes majeurs de la donnée traitée par Intescia est l’axe géographique. Vous prenez le relais de notre géomaticien qui évolue vers une autre équipe : vous avez de l’appétence et de l’expérience dans le traitement de la donnée géographique.

Vos activités :

Construire et industrialiser les pipelines de données

·         Concevoir, développer et maintenir les pipelines d'ingestion et de transformation de données.

·         Garantir la fiabilité, la fraîcheur, la qualité et la traçabilité des données produites.

·         Mettre en place le monitoring, les tests, l'alerting et la documentation associée.

Porter la migration vers Databricks

·         Contribuer activement à la conception de la cible : organisation du DataLakehouse, Unity Catalog, gouvernance, modèle de données.

·         Migrer les traitements existants et poser les standards (structuration des jobs, CI/CD, conventions, revue de code).

·         Diffuser les bonnes pratiques Spark / Delta au sein de l'équipe et accompagner sa montée en compétences.

Prendre en charge la dimension géographique

·         Industrialiser les traitements géospatiaux : géocodage, appariement d'adresses, jointures spatiales, agrégations par mailles administratives, gestion des projections et des référentiels.

·         Être le point de contact de l'équipe sur les référentiels géographiques et leurs évolutions.

Assumer un rôle de leadership technique

·         Être garant·e de la cohérence technique des solutions produites par l'équipe.

·         Animer les choix d'architecture, arbitrer et documenter les décisions.

·         Accompagner et faire monter en compétences les autres membres de l'équipe (revues de code, pair programming).

Stack technique

·         Environnement : Databricks

·         Langages : Python, SQL

·         Framework : Spark

·         Databases : ElasticSearch, Postgres

·         DevOps : Github Action (CI/CD), Docker

·         Monitoring : Grafana, Prometheus

  • La rémunération annuelle fixe sur ce poste sera entre 55K€ et 60K€ en fonction du profil que nous recruterons.

Le profil que nous recherchons :

Vos compétences :

  • L’usage de DATABRICKS sera un critère fortement apprécié

  • Capacité à porter techniquement un sujet de bout en bout et à embarquer les autres.

  • Clarté et transparence dans la communication

  • Leadership, référent au sein d'une équipe.

Expérience :

  • 5 ans et plus d'expérience en data engineering, sur des pipelines en production.

  • Très bonne maîtrise de Python et de SQL.

  • Très bonne maitrise du traitement de données distribué : Spark (PySpark).

  • Solide expérience de développement de pipelines de données sur Databricks

  • Pratique des standards d'ingénierie logicielle : Git, CI/CD, tests automatisés, revue de code, performance.

  • Expérience de l'orchestration (Airflow, Databricks Workflows ou équivalent).

  • Appétence réelle pour la donnée géographique : vous en avez déjà manipulé.

  • Compréhension des systèmes de projection (WGS84, Lambert 93) et des formats géospatiaux (GeoJSON, Shapefile, WFS etc).

  • Connaissance de PostGis (SQL Spatial) et QGIS.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

  • Situé à Carquefou, proche de Nantes, dans le cadre paisible et verdoyant du quartier de la Fleuriaye, à quelques pas de l’Erdre (Port-Jean), vous profiterez d’un cadre idéal pour allier productivité et bien-être.

  • Rémunération fixe annuelle de 55K€ à 60K€ en fonction du profil

  • Organisation hybride : Télétravail possible 3 jours par semaine après période d’essai.
